entries.zh: 脱帽（脱下帽子，再放回原处）
entries.en: to take off one's hat and put it back in its place
entries.notes: 官话栏「chi boⁿya utaxira [疑:utaxira/watxira]」难辨，依西语词头与汉字「脫帽仔」定为脱帽复置。

entries.zh: 强劫（强行劫夺他人财物；抢劫）
entries.en: to rob; to seize another's property by force
to take (something) by force; to strip by violence

entries.zh: 抢夺强占（强行抢占他人之物）
entries.en: to snatch away; to seize and occupy by force

entries.zh: 删减（删改文书，删去字句）
entries.en: to strike out or abridge a writing, removing words in correcting it
to cut off or shave the hair
entries.notes: 官话栏「chim mo asirar.」难解，依西语「quitar el cabello」与汉字「削伐」定为剪除毛发。

entries.en: to dispel dropsy (water swelling)
entries.notes: 西语词头「enso porrizir」残损难辨，依汉字「消水脹」与音写 sian-tsui-tió 定为消水肿。

entries.zh: 脱帽行礼（为礼节而摘帽）
entries.en: to doff one's hat as a courtesy
to refund; to give back or take back the money
entries.notes: 西语词头后半「y avicen tado [疑:avicen/avizen]」残损，依汉字「退錢」定为退钱。

entries.en: to shed its skin (as a cicada molting); cicada slough
entries.notes: 西语尾「ala yarra [疑:yarra/garra]」难解，依汉字「蟬退」定为蝉蜕。

entries.en: to remove a mole (by medicine/cautery)
to remove (someone) from his office
to dismiss (someone) from office; to retire him from his post
to strip (someone) of his office
entries.notes: 汉字作「點陟」，与西语「quitar el oficio」义不合，疑当作「褪」（除去）；官话栏空。

entries.en: to be rid of one's melancholy (the gloom dissipates)
to dispel melancholy; to console
entries.notes: 西语词头「gritteca [疑:gritteca/fifteca]」难辨；官话栏为西班牙语注「qitarla: y consolar」，定为除闷宽慰。

entries.en: to throw off the bedclothes on account of the heat
entries.notes: 西语词头「spadens [疑:spadens/speiras]」难辨，疑为 sábanas（床单），依汉字「露被」定为掀被。

entries.en: to cut off the head; to behead

entries.zh: 唾你（向人吐唾，以示嘲弄羞辱）
entries.en: to spit at you (in contempt/mockery)
entries.notes: 西语词头「Qvitarse ay, haciendo burla」句式残损，依汉字「唾你」定为吐唾嘲弄。

entries.zh: 罢黜其职并弃逐之（撤职丢开）
entries.en: to strip him of his office and cast him out
